note: F05: explicit knots, ypos2 | cens(cens_r) + bhaz(knots = c(1.5, 3), Boundary.knots = c(0, 6)) ~ x + (1 | g) (5 of 36 rows censored): brms hands bhaz()'s further arguments to splines2, so the interior knots are 1.5 and 3 and the boundary knots 0 and 6 (Y in [0.6779, 5.2572]); Kbhaz = 2 + 4 = 6. With knots a df is ignored (bhaz(df = 7, knots = c(1.5, 3)) gives the same 6 bases); Boundary.knots alone keeps the default interior knot, the median. brms's default Intercept location here is 0.5 (log of the median 1.71425)

brms.formula: ypos2 | cens(cens_r) + bhaz(knots = c(1.5, 3), Boundary.knots = c(0, 6)) ~ x + (1 | g)

autobayes.formula: ypos2 | cens(cens_r) + bhaz(knots = c(1.5, 3), Boundary.knots = c(0, 6)) ~ x + (1 | g)
